parent_objective: implement a no-update branch-preserving temporal repair evaluator
blocked_by: M1006 requires evaluator sanity before any repaired actor update
invalidates: actor update before branch-ceiling evaluator sanity

public_gates: M1007 must not update actor parameters
M1007 must preserve P0 actor inputs
M1007 must show branch-ceiling terms are active on M1002 proof-washing candidates
forbidden_shortcuts: do not imitate wrong-history degraded actions
do not run replay gates as promotion evidence
do not change actor input contract

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements no-update exact metrics for branch ceiling and branch separation on M267/M264 active rows
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: evaluator sanity only; no actor update, no replay promotion, no private holdout
stop_condition: stop if branch-ceiling loss is not finite
stop if M974 base does not reproduce near-zero branch retention loss
stop if M1002 proof-washing alphas do not activate the new branch terms
stop if evaluator changes actor parameters
fallback_plan: if evaluator is not sensitive, audit feature choice and active-row reconstruction
if active-row reconstruction is unreliable, synthesize the branch before another objective
if evaluator passes, route to actor_mean-only repaired update design

hypothesis: A no-update evaluator can expose branch-ceiling and branch-separation penalties that are near zero for M974 but positive for M1002 proof-washing candidates.
success_criteria: M974 base branch metrics are finite
M1002 alpha 0.01 and alpha 0.2 activate branch-retention penalties
M997 temporal metrics still reproduce M1000
failure_criteria: M1002 proof-washing candidates are not distinguishable from base

commands.name: evaluator
commands.command: implement and run branch-preserving temporal repair evaluator; output runs/m1007_v4_public_base_branch_preserving_temporal_repair_evaluator/summary.json

decision_rule: M1007 should route to actor_mean-only repaired update design only if the no-update branch terms are finite, base-safe, and active on M1002 proof-washing candidates.
